summary: Polar Power filed an 8-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 exchange agreement with CEO/Chairman Arthur Sams, who surrendered $614,700 of principal and accrued interest on company promissory notes in return for 683 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred (stated value $1,000/share) plus a three-year warrant on 382,276 common shares at a $1.34 initial exercise price. The preferred accrues a 10% annual dividend and converts at 90% of the lowest seven-day VWAP, subject to a floor. This is an insider debt-for-equity recapitalization, not a special situation; watch dilution and conversion overhang.
